description:
You are an MLOps engineer tasked with securing the tracking of machine learning experiment artifacts stored in the directory /home/user/mlops/artifacts/. You have discovered two main issues: 1. The artifacts directory is world-writable, introducing a security vulnerability. 2. Artifact log files in /home/user/mlops/artifacts/logs/ contain sensitive information (such as API keys) in plain text. Please complete the following steps: - **Step 1:** Change the permissions on /home/user/mlops/artifacts/ so that only the owner can write to it, and group/others can only read and execute files there. - **Step 2:** Recursively scan all log files in /home/user/mlops/artifacts/logs/ for any lines that match the patterns API_KEY=* and SECRET=*. - **Step 3:** For each instance of these secrets that you discover, remove the line entirely from the respective log file. - **Step 4:** Document your actions and findings in /home/user/mlops/security_fix_report.txt in the following format (replace file names and secrets with actual values you found and files you modified): 
[Permissions]
Changed permissions: /home/user/mlops/artifacts/ to 755

[Secrets Removed]
/home/user/mlops/artifacts/logs/experiment1.log:
  Removed line: API_KEY=abc123
  Removed line: SECRET=supersecret

/home/user/mlops/artifacts/logs/experiment2.log:
  Removed line: API_KEY=xyz789
Each removed line must be documented with the full line as originally present in the file. If a log file did not contain any secrets, do not mention it in the "[Secrets Removed]" section. Once completed, all the log files in /home/user/mlops/artifacts/logs/ should no longer contain any lines with API_KEY= or SECRET=, and the /home/user/mlops/security_fix_report.txt must exactly match the action summary above for automated verification.
